identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase Ⅲ Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Immunogenicity, Safety of Quadrivalent HPV Recombinant Vaccine in Chinese Healthy Females
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter,Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, and Double-blind Phase Ⅲ Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Immunogenicity and Safety of Quadrivalent Human Papillomavirus (Types 6, 11, 16, and 18) Recombinant Vaccine (Hansenula Polymorpha) in Chinese Female Aged 18-45 Years

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is designed to evaluate the vaccine efficacy, immunogenicity and safety of the 4-valent Human Papillomavirus (Types 6, 11, 16, and 18) Recombinant Vaccine (Hansenula Polymorpha) in Chinese Female Subjects Aged 18-45 Years .

armGroups.label: 4vHPV Vaccine
interventionNames: Biological: Quadrivalent Human Papillomavirus (Types 6, 11, 16, and 18) Recombinant Vaccine (Hansenula Polymorpha)

interventions.name: Quadrivalent Human Papillomavirus (Types 6, 11, 16, and 18) Recombinant Vaccine (Hansenula Polymorpha)

primaryOutcomes.measure: The person-year incidence of HPV 16 and 18-related CIN 2+ observed in Chinese women aged 18-45 years after receiving 3 doses of quadrivalent HPV vaccine at least 30 days ago.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The person-year incidence of HPV 6-, 11-, 16-, and 18-related 6-month Persistent Infection at least 30 days post Dose 3
The person-year incidence of HPV 6-, 11-, 16-, and 18-related 12-month Persistent Infection at least 30 days post Dose 3
The person-year incidence of HPV 6-, 11-, 16-, and 18-related disease (e.g., VIN1+ orAIN1+ or VAIN1+ and genital warts)
Percentage of Participants Who Report at any Injection-site and Systemic Adverse Event 30 minutes post any vaccination
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 30 minutes after any dose of vaccination

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of subjects with Adverse Events (AEs)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Subjects with solicited and unsolicited AEs

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of subjects with Severe adverse events (SAE)
secondaryOutcomes.description: SAEs assessed include medical occurrences that results in death, are life threatening, require hospitalization or prolongation of hospitalization, results in disability/incapacity or are a congenital anomaly/birth defect in the offspring of a study subjects.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of subjects with pregnancy events
secondaryOutcomes.description: Outcomes of pregnancies were Live infant NO apparent congenital anomaly (ACA) , Live infant, Elective termination NO ACA, Elective termination CA, Ectopic pregnancy, Spontaneous abortion NO ACA, Stillbirth, Lost to follow up and Pregnancy ongoing.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of subjects receiving the whole schedule vaccination with antibody responses as assessed by SCR
The neutralizing antibody level among the subjects receiving the whole schedule vaccination
The person-year incidence of non-vaccine-realted HPV types related CIN2+ observed in Chinese women aged 18-45 years at least 30 days post Dose 3
The person-year incidence of non-vaccine-realted HPV types related disease (e.g., VIN1+ or AIN1+ or VAIN1+ and genital warts) observed in Chinese women aged 18-45 years at least 30 days post Dose 3
The person-year incidence of HPV 6-, 11-, 16-, and 18-related 6-month and 12-month Persistent Infection at least 30 days post Dose 1
The person-year incidence of HPV 16- and 18-related CIN2+ at least 30 days post Dose 1
The person-year incidence of HPV 6-, 11-, 16- and 18-related diseases (e.g., VIN1+ or AIN1+ or VAIN1+ and genital warts) at least 30 days post Dose 1
